subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should installed, linked, and workspace hook packages require `HOOK.md` metadata to be a regular file rather than a symlink?
rationale: The memory-exhaustion fix is technically sound, but the selected helper deliberately removes a previously accepted local filesystem shape; repository history and docs do not establish that compatibility decision.

options.title: Standardize regular files
options.body: Keep the hardened readers and add consistent focused coverage documenting symlink rejection across install and discovery.

options.title: Preserve metadata symlinks
options.body: Use bounded descriptor reads that intentionally retain symlink support across all hook entry paths.

recommendation.title: Standardize regular files
recommendation.body: Keep the hardened readers and add consistent focused coverage documenting symlink rejection across install and discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the unified hook install behavior and owns the current-main hook/fs-safe lines most directly involved in this choice.
